distancePolicy.officialDistanceKm: Trail-manager or selected official user-facing distance.
distancePolicy.computedGeometryDistanceKm: Distance computed from selected normalized geometry.
distancePolicy.displayDistanceKm: Defaults to officialDistanceKm unless a trail-specific handoff selects a different value.
distancePolicy.distanceCaveats: Source contradictions, rounded totals, stale values and measured-distance notes.

sections.name: Västra Lägern - Skuruhatt
caveats: Smålandsleden/Naturkartan/Visit Eksjö describe Skuruhatt as 337 m above sea level, while Länsstyrelsen says 334 m above sea level.
HÖ1 page and Visit Eksjö say the gorge is about 800 m; Naturkartan's Skurugata text says about 1 km.
Some trail pages refer to Skuruhatt naturreservat, while the official protected area record is Skurugata, NVR 2002309.
SityTrail has an older 'Höglandsleden: Delsträcka 5, Klinten - Västra Lägern' of 5 km, created/updated in 2022. This does not match current official HÖ1 7.5 km Västra Lägern-Skuruhatt.

sections.name: Skuruhatt - Valbacken
caveats: Official title says Skuruhatt; route text says start at Skurugata; GPX starts at the Skurugata/Skuruhatt visitor area.

Official HÖ2 page states the trail has been rerouted before Hässleåsa gård and hikers should follow markings on site. Naturkartan GPX and API linework match each other and were updated/fetched in this research pass, but the page does not say whether the geometry fully reflects the reroute.
AllTrails, Pacer and SityTrail still use older Klinten-Ingatorp sectioning and shorter 29.6-31 km distances, while current official HÖ2 is Skuruhatt-Valbacken, 32.1 km.
HÖ2 page says Skurugata is 800 m and Skuruhatt 337 m above sea level; Länsstyrelsen describes the gorge as about 1 km and Skuruhatt as 334 m.
Official Naturkartan/Smålandsleden says 3-4 people; Vindskyddskartan reportedly says 4-6/sleeps 6.
Valbacken cafe/toilet/water are official but seasonal/opening-dependent; the toilet is closed in winter.
Official Länsstyrelsen material dated 2026-04-10 is a proposal/remiss for Nödjehultaåns naturreservat and explicitly mentions Höglandsleden at Hässleåsa damm. Final reserve status was not confirmed.

sections.name: Valbacken - Mariannelund
caveats: Current official Smålandsleden/Naturkartan calls the section HÖ3 Valbacken-Mariannelund, 16.7 km. OSM and route apps often use older names such as Delsträcka 4 Ingatorp-Mariannelund or Stage 6, with distances ranging from about 16.2 km to 25.8 km depending on packaging and variants.
Older OSM relation 10553744 computes to about 17.975 km and has its last point about 642 m from the current official Filmbyn endpoint.
The official connector text says 1.8 km, metadata says 1.9 km and computed official connector geometry is about 1.943 km.

Official pages list Åsjön as an active shelter with grill, beach and dry toilet; a 2020 field report described vandalism/litter/graffiti/no firewood, while later route-app tips again treat it as usable.

Official/local sources list cafe, toilet, water and restaurant services at endpoints, but field/route-app reports and official text indicate seasonal/opening-hour dependency, including Valbacken toilet closed in winter.
Some Visit Eksjö service pages include malformed or clearly wrong coordinate text. The HÖ3 synthesis uses official Smålandsleden/Naturkartan, OSM and facility-agent coordinates instead.
Official text says HÖ3 connects in Mariannelund toward Emilleden and the Kalmar county side via Severedsleden, but those are not part of the HÖ3 GPX line.

sections.name: Valbacken - Lilla Bjälkerum
caveats: Official URL slug says ho4-ingatorp-lilla-bjalkerum, but the official title and inventory say Valbacken - Lilla Bjälkerum. The GPX starts at Valbacken.
The section endpoint is officially Lilla Bjälkerum, while the official access POI is named Bjälkerum ledentré HÖ4/HÖ5.

OSM relation 10553871 and third-party route apps use older Ingatorp - Stora Bjälkerum / Delsträcka 6 naming and longer distances around 21-24 km, while current official HÖ4 is Valbacken - Lilla Bjälkerum, 20.5 km.

Local v2 API and geometry-lane checks found an exact GPX/API match with 1,059 vertices. One official-source lane note using a v3.2 endpoint mentioned denser GPX sampling than API shape. Use the downloaded GPX and v2 API geometry as the canonical import source and recheck API version at import time.
Bjälkerum ledentré is official, but the official page marks entrance only, not parking. Field/third-party notes suggest possible roadside or grass parking, but this is not official.

Official/Naturkartan/Eksjö sources support Lilla Bjälkerum shelter/grill, but 2020 field reports mention possible damp/leaky condition and no firewood. Vadholmen is field/OSM-supported but not official and carries verification caveats.

sections.name: Lilla Bjälkerum - Ädelfors
caveats: Official HÖ5 text/miniguide says the stage passes two nature reserves and names Tjusthult, while Länsstyrelsen says Smålandsleden passes just south of Tjusthult and connects by an about 800 m yellow trail.
Official HÖ5 difficulty is Blå - medel, but Djupaskuran-Lillån reserve sources describe demanding, steep, rocky/slippery terrain with chains.
OSM and route-app/legacy sources use Etapp 1 or Etapp 1:5 Fågelhult - Ädelfors/Repperda and distances around 22.3-23.0 km, while current official HÖ5 is Lilla Bjälkerum - Ädelfors, 24.2 km.
Official sources confirm a shelter/fireplace/toilet cluster at Ädelfors. Facility/rules lanes distinguish the free municipal Klondike shelter from other nearby fee-based Gold Camp shelters/services.
Commercial Gold Camp sources mention drinking water for guests/caravans, but no official public trail water POI was found.
A 2020 field report described flooding and poor marking after clearcuts, while a sparse AllTrails 2025 signal indicates good conditions. No official closure/reroute exists.

sections.name: Ädelfors - Högarps kulturreservat
caveats: Official distance is 20.6 km; computed GPX distance is about 20.623 km and v3.2 API simplified linework is about 20.617 km. This is consistent rounding/simplification, not a material contradiction.

Current official HÖ6 is Ädelfors - Högarps kulturreservat, 20.6 km. OSM/reused route-app sources describe old Ädelfors/Repperda - Stenberga or Ädelfors - Lindshammar framing around 25.4-25.6 km and do not end at the current Högarp/HÖ7 endpoint.
The section endpoint is labeled Högarps kulturreservat, while the protected-area/visitor-site name is Högarps by.
Two official-ish Högarp toilet records appear near each other around km 20.1, with coordinates roughly 57.337166,15.486938 and 57.337114,15.487684.

Official HÖ6 text says west of Högarps kulturreservat there is a rest area with shelter, grill and dry toilet. Facilities lane identifies a near-Högarp cluster and a separate Vallby cluster farther west.
Fire-ban pages describe ban levels and dynamic rules; absence of a municipal notice on 2026-04-29 is not proof of future permission.
Run GIS overlay to confirm whether the official HÖ6 route and the Högarp shelter/fireplace cluster enter the formal Högarps by cultural-reserve boundary or only approach it.
Deduplicate the two official-ish Högarp dry-toilet records before facility import.
Recheck live fire-ban status at import/trip-planning time via Länsstyrelsernas fire-ban map, Brandrisk Ute or Vetlanda notices.
Confirm locally whether Storm Dave windthrow affected HÖ6 specifically and whether any leaning/fallen trees remain.
Recheck JLT line 335/344/353 timetables after the current 2025-08-11 to 2026-06-14 PDF period.
Field-check any possible drinking-water taps; current official sources do not identify public potable water on HÖ6.

sections.name: Högarps kulturreservat - Lemnhult
caveats: Current official HÖ7 is Högarps kulturreservat - Lemnhult, 21.7 km. Legacy sources describe Etapp 3:5 Stenberga - Lemnhult at about 16-16.3 km, starting about 4 km from the current HÖ7 start and not matching current sectioning.
The HÖ7 nearby list did not expose Lemnhult ledentré, but HÖ8/API has Lemnhult, ledentré HÖ7/HÖ8 matching the HÖ7 endpoint within about 3.2 m.
Naturkartan labels the spur Helvetes Håla, while Länsstyrelsen uses Helvetets håla. The protected area is nearby/spur context, not necessarily a main-line HÖ7 overlap.
Hålebäcken grill near-water flag and Trollebo bathing water do not identify public drinking water.
Jättabacken has duplicate/overlapping toilet records around 57.28967,15.27432. Rest-cabin text mentions trash at the bottom of the hill while the grill object says no trash.
Länsstyrelsen says Smålandsleden passes through Stora och Lilla Fly, but HÖ7 GPX nearest point to its parking is about 5.2 km. This appears more relevant to HÖ8.
Run GIS overlay against Högarps by and Helvetets håla boundaries before assigning reserve rules to route segments.
Verify whether Helvetets Håla and Trollebo badplats should be modeled as HÖ7 spur/access metadata or suppressed in a main-route-only import.
Deduplicate Jättabacken toilet records before import.
Verify inconsistent waste metadata at Jättabacken and Högarp before importing waste facilities.
Verify exact coordinates for HÖ7 sägenskåp, Vättehult/Pälle Näver cabin and Gölaberget viewpoint before individual POI import.
Recheck live fire-ban status before import/trip guidance.

sections.name: Lemnhult - Lindshammar
caveats: Official current HÖ8 is Lemnhult-Lindshammar, 16.5 km. Several route-app/tourism/PDF sources preserve older Lemnhult-Lökarydssjön or Etapp 4:5 framing around 21 km.

Smålandsleden text says the dry toilet is about 200 m from reserve parking, while coordinate-backed records put toilet/picnic/parking together and the shelter/fireplace about 200 m east along the route.
Official HÖ8 text mentions Jättabacken facilities, but HÖ8 nearby/API objects do not include them and the coordinate-backed Jättabacken cluster belongs to the HÖ7/Lemnhult boundary area.

Facilities lane found differing capacity wording, roughly 5-6 cars in Länsstyrelsen context versus lower Naturkartan wording, and the Naturkartan parking record may be older/unpublished in API context.

Trail/Naturkartan side-trail wording may use Helvets/Helvetes variants, while Länsstyrelsen uses Helvetets håla. The reserve appears near the Lemnhult endpoint but is not proven to be part of the HÖ8 main route.
Run GIS overlay to scope exactly where HÖ8 crosses Stora och Lilla Fly and whether any Helvetets håla boundary intersects the main route.
Check the legal decision/PDF or posted signs for Stora och Lilla Fly before final camping wording; the visitor page did not explicitly ban ordinary tenting.
Field-check Stora/Lilla Fly boardwalk condition, post-Storm-Dave windthrow, shelter condition and dry-toilet availability before high-confidence trip guidance.
Deduplicate Stora Fly parking/toilet/picnic/info records and resolve the toilet-distance wording conflict.
Deduplicate Lindshammar ledentré HÖ8/HÖ9 and Lindshammar ledstart before import.
Verify whether Stora Fly parking should be imported as a public facility or only kept as access metadata because of record freshness/capacity uncertainty.
Recheck JLT line 352 and 345 timetables after the 2025-08-11 to 2026-06-14 period.

sections.name: Lindshammar - Ramkvilla
caveats: Official current HÖ9 is Lindshammar-Ramkvilla, 20.4 km. OSM splits this corridor into legacy Lindshammar-Lökarydssjön and Lökarydssjön-Ramkvilla-Torp relations with older endpoints.
Official HÖ9 narrative says Lökaryd has the rest area, but linked/API coordinate-backed facility records are named Sars.

Official lane reports Avstickare Boskvarnasjön API length 0.2 km, while description says about 350 m. HÖ9 API neighbor includes unpublished/null badplats-like id 128100, while the public bathing-place page uses site id 51794.
Naturkartan lists HÖ9 under Jönköpings län/Vetlanda, but the GPX starts in Uppvidinge/Kronoberg and ends in Vetlanda/Jönköping.
Route-app distances/labels vary: Wikiloc 21.84 km, Komoot 19.481/19.5 km, Komoot legacy Höglandsleden E4/Smålandsleden 14 labels, while official HÖ9 is 20.4 km.
Facilities lane found OSM Sunday opening status conflicted with ICA official Sunday closed information.

Rules lane noted Länsstyrelsen Jönköping page contains generic text headed as if an open-burning prohibition order applies, while the live fire-ban layer said no ban for Vetlanda/Uppvidinge on 2026-04-29.
Verify whether Sars official facility cluster should display with Lökaryd as an alias or rest-area label during normalization.
Verify Ramkvilla bus-stop coordinates from a primary transit/GTFS source before importing coordinate-backed commute access.
Keep Lindshammar parking pending/private-business context unless an official public trailhead parking source is found.
Verify Sars dry-toilet current condition if presenting it as reliable current facility.
Resolve Boskvarnasjön null/unpublished API neighbor id 128100 versus public badplats page/site id 51794 before importing off-route bathing/access metadata.

sections.name: Ramkvilla - Asa
caveats: Public HÖ10 pages are under Jönköpings län, but official narrative and endpoint/POI records show the section crosses into Kronoberg/Växjö near Asa.
Feresjön objects appear in Kronoberg/Växjö geography but some official records list Vetlanda kommun as contact/organization.
Research inventory treats HÖ10 as part of the main loop, while public route pages/API expose HÖ10 as a point-to-point stage from Ramkvilla to Asa.
API length is 0.2 km while description says 240 m to the rest area.
Smålandsleden brand-page GPX-style target and direct .gpx/.geojson/.kml variants did not provide usable geometry; the locale Naturkartan GPX works.
OSM relation 15419729 covers Ramkvilla-Asa-Sävsjö rather than HÖ10 only, has a 54 km tag but 75.796 km computed length, reverse member order and Asa-side divergence from official GPX.
Local page says the wärdshus is closed while OSM still maps a hotel.
Facilities lane found third-party bath pages may claim toilets, while Vetlanda municipal page says no toilet/no grill.
Verify whether HÖ10 crosses the Ramkvilla groundwater-protection zones; the official PDF map was not georeferenced in this pass.
Run a formal GIS overlay before attaching Asa domänreservat/Kråketorpskogen rules to HÖ10; current evidence suggests near-route detour context rather than direct route overlap.
Verify Ramkvilla Wärdshus current operating status before importing as lodging/food.
Verify exact public parking POIs in Asa; current evidence is area-level rather than an exact ledentré parking marker.

sections.name: Asa - Hultsjö
caveats: The main HÖ11 trail card is filed under Jönköpings län/Sävsjö, but official endpoint evidence puts Asa/start in Kronobergs län/Växjö and Hultsjö/end in Jönköpings län/Sävsjö.
Whole-trail topology treats HÖ11 as part of the main loop, while the stage itself is point-to-point from Asa to Hultsjö.
Current official side-trail API reports 0.1 km; older municipal PDF wording indicates about 200 m.
Older municipal PDF says waste stand, while the facilities lane found a shelter-app report saying no trash can.
HÖ12 and recent field context support water at Hultsjö church/cemetery, but the HÖ11 page itself names only Asa herrgård for water.
Rules lane overlay found Övingen Natura 2000 about 2 m from sampled GPX but not strictly intersecting it.
No HÖ11-specific relation found. Broad OSM relation 15419729 overlaps the corridor but is not stage-specific and has distance/member-chain contradictions.
Older sources mix Sävsjöleden/Njudungsleden/Höglandsleden framing around Asa-Hultsjö.
Verify seasonal/public access and exact tap coordinate for drinking water at Asa Herrgård and Hultsjö church/cemetery.
Confirm whether Hultsjö/Slagetorp currently has any waste/bin handling, and suppress waste import unless a current official source confirms it.
Confirm Hultsjö endpoint parking or other signed trailhead access if needed for runtime guidance.
If importing protected-area overlays, run final GIS intersection against the official GPX to decide whether Övingen Natura 2000 is an intersecting rule area or adjacent shoreline caution.

sections.name: Hultsjö - Sävsjö
caveats: Smålandsleden/Naturkartan HÖ12 exposes no closure/current status, but Sävsjö municipality reported the Eksjöhovgårdssjön exercise loop fully closed after Storm Dave on 2026-04-07.
HÖ12 official prose names Bockudden shelter as an overnight option, but geometry places it on a separate side trail. Official spur length is 0.9 km; computed GPX/API is 0.808 km.
Connector is titled HÖ12/HÖ13 and officially supports station access, but linework attaches near HÖ13 about 421 m from the HÖ12 endpoint.
Official HÖ12 route text references Hultsjö and Hjärtlanda 1100s churches, while Svenska kyrkan says current Hultsjö church was built 1859-1860.
Official HÖ12 prose says Sävsjö slottsruin, while linked facility/municipal sources use Eksjöhovgårds slottsruin.
Official HÖ12 prose names water at Hultsjö and Hjärtlanda cemeteries, but no exact tap coordinates or seasonal reliability were found.
OSM relations 15419729 and 15419730 overlap/approach the corridor but have stale or non-sectioned metadata and member-order/gap problems.
Has the 2026-04-07 Eksjöhovgårdssjön exercise-loop closure been lifted, and does it affect the HÖ12 endpoint, Bockudden side trail, or only the local exercise loop?
Verify exact public tap coordinates and seasonal reliability for Hultsjö and Hjärtlanda cemetery water.
Decide whether Bockudden should be surfaced as an optional HÖ12 spur with round-trip distance impact.
Decide whether Sävsjö C connector should attach to HÖ12, HÖ13, or the shared HÖ12/HÖ13 trailhead node in app UX.
Verify Hultsjö church historical wording before importing it as an 1100s-church narrative point.

sections.name: Sävsjö - Forsa
caveats: Official GPX and v2 API expose 470-point linework, while Naturkartan v3.2 exposes a simplified 306-point line. This is a simplification, not a route contradiction.
OSM relation 15419730 covers the broad Sävsjö-Vikskvarn corridor but starts near the Sävsjö C connector junction, missing the official first about 0.52 km from Eksjöhovgårdssjön.
Official HÖ13 pages show no closure/reroute status, but Sävsjö municipality reported Storm Dave closures/warnings in the start-area landscape on 2026-04-07.
Sources variously use Forsa badplats, Bringetofta badplats, Forsabadet and Toftabadet for the endpoint cluster.
AllTrails Vikskvarn-Sävsjö is a broader 24 km composite route, not exact HÖ13.
Recheck Sävsjö municipality after 2026-04-29 for a reopening/clearing notice for Eksjöhovgårdssjön and Djurgårdsområdet before user-facing import.
Verify the OSM-only shelter/fireplace near km 8.2 against a current official source or field report before importing.
Resolve Forsa endpoint deduplication: Forsa badplats aggregate, Rastplats Toftabadet, Forsabadet shelter, toilet, parking and swimming should not create duplicate clutter.
Confirm whether the Forsabadet shelter subcoordinate should be represented as a separate shelter or merged into the Forsa/Toftabadet service cluster.
Verify exact current public transport options for the Forsa endpoint on the intended travel date; no close fixed-route stop was found.

sections.name: Forsa - Vikskvarn
caveats: Official GPX and v2 API expose 523-point linework, while v3.2 API exposes simplified 368-coordinate MultiLineString linework. Endpoints/envelope agree.

OSM relation 15419730 is tagged Sävsjö-Vikskvarn and combines HÖ13+HÖ14 instead of sectioning HÖ14 separately. It is geometrically close for the HÖ14 subset but stale relative to official 2026 linework.

Rules lane initially reported no official potable water source found on HÖ14, but official/facility sources confirm Fällhemmet vattenpost as category Dricksvatten at 57.5094657/14.6179071. Vikskvarn water remains ambiguous because only the shelter page says nearest water is at the raststuga.

General Länsstyrelsen fire-ban page explains current fire-ban mapping and prohibition levels, while point-specific MSB API returned Inget eldningsförbud for HÖ14 coordinates on 2026-04-29 with riskIndex 3.
Sources variously use Forsa badplats, Bringetofta badplats, Forsabadet and Toftabadet for the start cluster.
Official-source lane noted a toftabadet-vindskydd context object/search result that returned 404 during access.
Recheck official Smålandsleden/Naturkartan and Länsstyrelsen Vikskvarn current notices before user-facing import; no HÖ14 closure/reroute was found on 2026-04-29.
Verify Fällhemmet waterpost hours, winter status and current flow before presenting it as reliable user-facing potable water.
Verify whether Vikskvarn raststuga has potable water or only an unclassified water reference before importing any Vikskvarn water source.
Resolve Forsa endpoint deduplication with HÖ13: grouped Forsa badplats plus split toilet/parking/swimming/shelter records should not create duplicates.
Resolve Vikskvarn endpoint deduplication: grouped ledentré categories should not duplicate raststuga, vindskydd, mulltoa and parking/access records.
Decide whether Rastplats Mattarps bokskog at about 273 m off the official GPX is within the import detour threshold.

sections.name: Vikskvarn - Lövhult
caveats: OSM relation 15421959 mostly matches the official route but diverges near Lövhult by up to about 608 m and has two continuity gaps. It appears to continue toward Lövhult village while official 2026 geometry ends at Lövhult friluftsområde.
API v2 linework and GPX expose 542-point linework, while v3.2 API exposes a 443-vertex MultiLineString that appears simplified/dedensified. Endpoints and computed distance agree.
Smålandsleden/Naturkartan nearby inventory includes Fällhemmet waterpost, Falla mosse and Bäckafall, but proximity checks place them off the HÖ15 GPX.
Lövhult Friluftsområde/Naturkartan text appears to mislabel some outgoing Höglandsleden sections, including HÖ17/HÖ18 wording that conflicts with official HÖ16/HÖ18 section pages.
Official description contains typo-like text 'historiskt odlingslandskap.stra Bråna'.
Länsstyrelsen Lövhult page says facilities are not yet shown in its map system, while Naturkartan/Smålandsleden and Nässjö municipality have detailed facility objects and service pages.

Rules lane listed Fällhemmet waterpost as official potable water, but facilities/proximity work shows it is about 2.8 km off HÖ15 and more consistent with adjacent/shared sections. Lövhult water is the strongest HÖ15-relevant source, while Vikskvarn water remains ambiguous.
Recheck official Smålandsleden/Naturkartan, Länsstyrelsen reserve news and Nässjö Lövhult current notices before user-facing import; no HÖ15 closure/reroute was found on 2026-04-29.
Verify exact Lövhult drinking-water tap coordinate and any seasonal/opening dependency before presenting it as reliable user-facing water.
Verify whether Vikskvarn raststuga has potable water or only an unclassified water reference before importing any Vikskvarn water source.
Resolve Vikskvarn endpoint deduplication with HÖ14 and HÖ18: grouped ledentré categories should not duplicate raststuga, vindskydd, mulltoa and parking/access records.
Resolve Lövhult endpoint deduplication with HÖ16: grouped ledentré categories should not duplicate camping, parking, water, cafe/service, hostel, shelters and fireplaces.

sections.name: Lövhult - Ränneborg
caveats: Official structured facts/API length is 24.1 km, while official prose says 23.7 km. Official GPX computes to 24.076949 km.
Naturkartan API assigns HÖ16 to Nässjö municipality, but official prose says the route ends at Ränneborg in Eksjö and the next HÖ17 stage is assigned to Eksjö.
OSM relation 15422103 is tagged Lövhult-Eksjö and overlaps HÖ16 but extends beyond official Ränneborg endpoint.
Official Smålandsleden text says bus access via stop 'Ränneborg', while current JLT/GTFS evidence found Eksjö Ränneslätt as the closest confirmed useful stop.
Official sources map Svartåns källa as drinking water, but facility/rules lanes found flow and water quality vary seasonally and current potability/treatment/sampling were not confirmed.
Official HÖ16 text names Fiskaretorpsåsen as a highlight, but the Visit Eksjö coordinate interpreted by facilities lane lies east of the Ränneborg endpoint and was not reconciled with HÖ16 GPX.
Recheck official Smålandsleden/Naturkartan and Länsstyrelsen reserve current notices before user-facing import; no HÖ16 closure/reroute was found on 2026-04-29.
Resolve the official distance contradiction: structured facts and GPX support 24.1 km, while official prose says 23.7 km.
Verify Svartåns källa current flow, public access, treatment/sampling and seasonal reliability before presenting it as reliable drinking water.
Resolve Lövhult endpoint deduplication with HÖ15 and HÖ16: grouped entrance categories should not duplicate camping, parking, water, shelters and fireplaces.
Resolve Ränneborg endpoint deduplication with HÖ17 and verify whether the official bus stop name 'Ränneborg' still exists or should be represented by Eksjö Ränneslätt/Eksjö station.
Decide whether Ärnanäs shelter, Lövhult Timmerstuga/wind shelter and other local-spur facilities fall within import detour thresholds.

sections.name: Ränneborg - Skuruhatt
caveats: No explicit API prev/next field was exposed. Numbering and endpoint labels imply HÖ16 connects at Ränneborg and HÖ1/HÖ2 connect at Skuruhatt, but the miniguide display order around HÖ17 was not the same as walking direction.

The GPX endpoint aligns with the Skurugata/Skuruhatt parking/entrance area, while the Skuruhatt viewpoint itself is about 32 m off/near the final route segment and the official endpoint marker is about 17.873 m from GPX end.
Main-thread API v2 geometry matches GPX at 743 vertices; geometry lane reported v3.2 JSON:API linework at 525 vertices and 18.437323 km, with max segment 225.632 m.
Geometry lane reported the embedded non-localized GPX URL resolved to HTML, while the localized Naturkartan GPX URL works.

Official/Naturkartan text mentions bus stop Ränneborg, but the transit lane could not verify an active JLT stop page or coordinates with that exact name; closest verified active stop found was Eksjö Västra Brudbadet.

Official nearby inventory and facilities strongly support Klinten relevance, but rules lane cautioned exact HÖ17-only GPX intersection with Klinten reserve should be confirmed before segment-scoped reserve rules.
Rules lane found no confirmed potable water on official HÖ17/Ränneborg/Skuruhatt main pages, while facilities lane found official Skidstugan drinking-water metadata via an off-route side trail.

Verify whether an active JLT stop named Ränneborg exists or whether official wording should be replaced with verified nearby stops such as Eksjö Västra Brudbadet, Eksjö Ränneslätt and Eksjö Resecentrum.
GIS-confirm exact HÖ17 intersection with Klinten reserve before attaching route-segment reserve rules beyond facility/context metadata.
Deduplicate Skurugata/Skuruhatt endpoint facilities with existing HÖ1 and HÖ2 research before import.
Decide import policy for off-route but officially connected Skidstugan and Klinten/Försjön facilities.
Verify Skidstugan water availability/potability and seasonality before presenting it as reliable water.

sections.name: Vikskvarn - Tomtabacken
caveats: Canonical slug and URLs use ho18-tomtabacken-vikskvarn, but the visible official title, description, GPX/API direction and endpoint topology all support Vikskvarn to Tomtabacken.
Official miniguide list order places HÖ19 before HÖ18 and HÖ17 after HÖ18, while physical endpoint topology links HÖ18 to HÖ14/HÖ15 at Vikskvarn and HÖ19 at Tomtabacken.
Official HÖ18 visible nearby list includes HÖ14 and HÖ15 around Vikskvarn but omits HÖ19, while Tomtabacken entrance and HÖ19 page confirm the HÖ18/HÖ19 connection.
Neighbour API includes several unpublished objects with show_on_naturkartan=true, including Vikskvarn eldstad and Tomtabacken shelter/fire/info/parking. These differ from visible public page objects.

Facilities lane found OSM cluster coordinates around 57.5018/14.4942 on HÖ18. Rules/currentness lane reported an older field-source approximate coordinate around 57.50032/14.47008, which appears closer to the Tomtabacken approach and inconsistent with the shelter cluster.
Official pages confirm toilets, shelters/rest areas and overnight/rest facilities at endpoints, but no HÖ18 drinking-water category or confirmed public potable-water point was found.
Geometry lane noted GPX metadata time appears generated at request/download time.
Deduplicate Vikskvarn endpoint facilities with HÖ14 and HÖ15, and Tomtabacken endpoint facilities with HÖ19 before import.
GIS-confirm HÖ18 intersections with Vikskvarn and Fallamosse östra official Skyddad natur boundaries before attaching segment-scoped protected-area rules.
Verify whether any current official Smålandsleden/Naturkartan or municipal object confirms the Älmhultasjön/S. Älmhult shelter/toilet/picnic cluster before importing it above medium confidence.
Confirm Vikskvarn raststuga water wording before presenting any Vikskvarn water as public potable drinking water.
Recheck HÖ18, Vikskvarn and Fallamosse östra official pages, local notices, Brandrisk Ute/fire-ban status and any post-Storm Dave trail-clearing notices before publication or route guidance.

sections.name: Tomtabacken - Hok
caveats: Official Tomtabacken ledentré object is titled/contextualized as HÖ18/HÖ19 but has slug tomtabacken-ledentre-ho15ho16.
Official nearby inventory reports about 1.4 km while description text reports about 1.6 km for the Hok station-HÖ19/HÖ20 connector.
Smålandsleden lists Anslutning Lyngemadens naturreservat near HÖ19, but official WFS/GPX corridor check found no HÖ19 mainline overlap with Lyngemadssjön reserve.
OSM relation 15423257 covers broader Vikskvarn-Hok context but does not cleanly model the official HÖ19/HÖ20 Hok endpoint.
API v2 linework matched the 801-point GPX, while geometry lane reported simplified v3.2 linework with 608 points and a long max segment. Main-thread direct v3.2 check returned 401 unauthenticated.
Official ledentré marker is about 16 m from the HÖ19 GPX start, while a practical summit/rest-area parking coordinate was inferred about 305 m away.

Official endpoint/service context lists water at Hok/Hook herrgård and facilities lanes found natural/historic/unknown water notes, but no reliable public potable source was confirmed between endpoints.
Leva Café Hemma website said 2026 is its final season.

JLT confirms the bus stop but did not expose coordinates to the transit lane; coordinate is approximate from OSM road geometry.
Official-source lane reported API publish_gpx null even though direct GPX download works.

Official connector is reported as 1.6 km in HTML/page text and 1.5 km in API according to agent reports.
Connector name says Byarum kyrka - HÖ20/HÖ22, but HÖ21 starts at Byarum and the connector is described from Byarum hembygdsgård to Byarum church/bus stop.

Official route text highlights Södra Duveled and one planning source references Södra Duveled Natura 2000, while WFS rules lane found the relevant near/on-route protected feature as Norra Duveled biotopskydd within about 2 m and did not find confident direct Natura 2000 overlap.
Official/facilities lanes report a water tap on the north side of Byarums hembygdsgård, but exact tap coordinate, public access and seasonality are not independently verified.
OSM relation 15427009 has good topology but endpoints are tens of meters from official GPX/ledentré positions and member total is 16.415 km versus official GPX about 16.325 km.
Official-source lane noted API/page text typo Hölandsleden.

sections.name: Skillingaryd - Åsafors
caveats: Official section title says Skillingaryd - Åsafors, but the actual HÖ21/HÖ22 main-trail node and GPX start are at Grönelund west of Skillingaryd. Skillingaryd station is an access connector, not the mainline endpoint.

Official text indicates Åsafors is near road access and pickup/dropoff is possible, but also says there is no direct parking. Transit lane found no fixed-route Åsafors stop and nearest sparse line-254 stops are about 9 km away.
Rules lane reported Länsstyrelsen Jönköping rendered an open-burning-prohibition heading, while the official municipal fire-ban map service reported Inget eldningsförbud for Vaggeryd and Gnosjö.
Kylås appears as an official nearby object and lies on the HÖ22 corridor, but Naturkartan/Kylås sources describe it as bookable/private and not Smålandsleden-managed.
Bissefäll is municipality-confirmed bookable lodging, while nearby Hagstad Raststuga has OSM/Vindskyddskartan evidence but is absent from official HÖ22 nearby places.
OSM relation 15427025 spans Grönelund-Kärringabacka, combining HÖ22 and HÖ23, and has non-navigation-grade member ordering.
API v2 linework matches the GPX exactly with 1103 vertices, while API v3.2 has simplified 744-coordinate linework.
Naturkartan transit widgets reported no stops, while JLT/GTFS and Smålandsleden confirm Skillingaryd station and bus service.
Model the HÖ22 start as Grönelund/Skillingaryd and keep Skillingaryd station as connector metadata; do not snap the mainline to the station.
Fetch/check Skillingaryd station connector geometry and distance; sources continue to conflict between 1.5 and 1.6 km.
Keep Åsafors as pickup/dropoff only; do not import parking or nearby public transport without new evidence.
Verify Bissefäll booking/access terms before importing as active bookable lodging.

sections.name: Åsafors - Kärringabacka
caveats: Official inventory/title and entrance use Kärringabacka, while slug/body text/adjacent route titles often use Kärringsbacka or karringsbacka.
Official J1 and J2 titles say Hestra-Kärringabacka and Töllstorp-Kärringabacka, but their GPX geometries start at Kärringabacka.
OSM relation 15427025 models a broad Grönelund-Kärringabacka Höglandsleden corridor spanning HÖ22 and HÖ23, not standalone HÖ23.
The OSM Kärringabacka hamlet node is close to but not the official trail endpoint. Official GPX and Naturkartan entrance marker define the endpoint.
Kylås appears in official nearby context but lies about 1.96 km from HÖ23 GPX and is bookable/private, not Smålandsleden-managed.
Naturkartan widgets show no stops while JLT/GTFS contains sparse regional stops within several kilometres of Kärringabacka and much farther from Åsafors.
Rules lane found no active fire ban in queried relevant municipalities on 2026-04-30, but fire restrictions are volatile and controlled by live municipal/county decisions.

OSM and TillSkogs both show a shelter-like record at 57.4633969/13.8393272, but neither provides a name, official status, photos, user visits, public-access terms, condition, fire/toilet/water details, or Smålandsleden/Naturkartan corroboration. OSM history also shows a DWG revert for undocumented import after a TillSkogs website link was added.
Only field or official verification can make the OSM/TillSkogs lean-to at 57.4633969/13.8393272 importable; suppress it from HÖ23 import until then.
Fire-ban status and post-Storm-Dave trail clearance are live/currentness checks; recheck immediately before publication or trip guidance, but they are not structural research blockers.

If direct endpoint transit becomes a product requirement, verify practical walking routes from Götarps Brunn/Götarp/Gnosjö Törestorp to Kärringabacka; otherwise keep HÖ23 direct access classified as weak and use J1/J2 continuation access.
If Järnbärarleden J1/J2 is imported later, deduplicate the Kärringabacka endpoint and preserve geometry orientation despite title-order mismatch.
